title: Misleading advertisement
description: A manufacturer or service provider who makes a misleading advertisement

content.offence: A manufacturer or service provider who causes a false or misleading advertisement to be made which is prejudicial to the interest of consumers
content.punishment: Imprisonment for a term which may extend to two years, and with fine which may extend to ten lakh rupees; and for every subsequent offence, imprisonment for a term which may extend to five years and with fine which may extend to fifty lakh rupees
